visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair wearing a white distressed t-shirt with holes stands in a bustling outdoor night market at night. He gestures towards the camera with a cheerful expression, pointing around the setting. The background includes scaffolding, various market stalls with warm lights, and blurred figures of passers-by. (2) A close-up shot shows a pair of hands pouring a vibrant yellow-orange juice from a plastic pitcher into a light green paper cup held by another hand. The background is a slightly blurred juice stall. (3) The camera pans to a red and yellow signage for a food stall named 'Hongding Soup Dumplings'. A woman wearing a pink hairnet and an apron is seen preparing food behind a counter stacked with bamboo steamers. (4) The man returns to the frame holding a round bamboo steamer filled with soup dumplings. He uses chopsticks to pick up a large, translucent dumpling, holding it close to the camera lens to show its texture. (5) A macro shot focuses on the soup dumpling being split open, revealing a juicy pork and vegetable filling inside with steam rising. (6) The scene shifts to another bamboo steamer containing elongated steamed dumplings (jiaozi). A close-up shows one being picked up, revealing a thin, semi-transparent skin and a filling of pork and cabbage. (7) A close-up of a food stall sign 'Zhenmiao Fried Chicken' is followed by a shot of a piece of golden-brown fried chicken being pulled apart by hands in purple gloves, showing a stretchy white cheese filling inside. (8) The man appears again, now looking distressed and wiping sweat from his forehead. The screen turns grayscale with stylized black doodle-like overlays representing heat or stress. (9) He quickly transitions to a happy expression, holding a smartphone that displays a yellow screen with the 'PXPay Plus' logo. He points his finger at the screen. (10) A series of screen recordings show the mobile app interface, featuring transaction logs, cashback percentages like 3% and 9%, and icons of various Taiwanese banks. (11) The man stands back in the market holding both the green juice cup and the smartphone, smiling broadly and gesturing confidently as he speaks to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a fast pace. The background music is an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 drum beat. Ambient market noise is muffled. (2) As the visuals cut to food, the speaker's tone becomes more enthusiastic and descriptive, emphasizing vowels. A soft 'ding' sound effect triggers when variety text appears on screen. (3) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs during scene changes. The music remains continuous. The speaker maintains a professional yet friendly narrative style, with high pitch variability indicating excitement about the food. (4) A sudden shift in vocal arousal happens as the speaker portrays distress; his pitch drops slightly and speed slows for dramatic effect. A comedic 'record scratch' or subtle tonal dip is heard. (5) As the smartphone appears, a sharp 'pop' sound effect occurs. The speaker's voice regains high intensity and brightness, explaining the payment app. (6) During the screen recording segments, digital UI sound effects like soft clicks or pings accompany the appearance of cashback figures. The BGM maintains its steady tempo. (7) The final phase features a very fast, high-pitched call to action with the speaker's voice projecting strongly over the music, which swells slightly in volume toward the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Evidence -> Conflict -> Resolution -> Evidence -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog to encourage viewers to use the 'PXPay Plus' (全支付) mobile payment app. It begins by hooking the audience with a food tour of Neihu's 737 Alley night market. After showing tempting local snacks, it introduces a common conflict—running out of cash while at the market. It then provides the resolution by demonstrating that the app is accepted at these stalls and offers significant cashback rewards, concluding with a referral code to incentivize new users.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly holds a phone showing the app interface, explains specific cashback percentages (3%, 9%), and provides a personal referral code for registration.
